text:
aj: Noticed a p95 regression on streaming.chat after last selector tweak. Short requests (10-30 tokens) jump from ~26ms to ~33ms p95.

maria: Which change landed? Kernel selection or batching heuristics?

aj: Kernel-selection patch (v2.3-selector) started pre-merging small windows to favor the wide-kernel path. Deployed to canary at 9860000000.

sasha: Any profiling traces?

aj: Captured a quick host sampler. Key slices:
```
parse_total: 1.64ms
  proto_unwrap: 0.40ms
  demux: 0.72ms
  hpack: 0.15ms
  copy/serialize: 0.37ms
kv_probe: 0.10ms
kernel_select: 0.08ms
```
demux time is the outlier vs baseline (~0.35ms).

kevin: Demux bumped. Could be extra scanning/copies from pre-merge. Also watch for writev syscall count rising which can hit tail for tiny responses.

aj: Ran local microbench (20-token payload): old-selector p95 parse 0.85ms, new-selector p95 parse 1.75ms. End-to-end p95 aligned with that.

maria: Can you grab strace on canary to see writev counts? If demux splits frames we may go from 1 writev -> 2-4 writev per response.

aj: Strace samples show writev calls/request increased 1 -> 3 on average for tiny streaming updates.

sasha: That aligns. Pre-merge scanning probably does a temporary buffer and then re-emit framed chunks causing extra iov.

kevin: Two avenues: gate the pre-merge for small payloads OR optimize demux to detect tiny frames and fast-path without allocations. Which is faster to ship?

maria: Gate first. Less risky. Suggest threshold: only pre-merge when payload > 1KB OR seq_len > 256.

aj: Implemented a quick bypass: if payload_bytes < 1024 && tokens < 64 skip pre-merge. Local run: parse p95 ~0.9ms, overall p95 drops to ~28-30ms.

sasha: Great. Open a PR with microbench CSV, strace snippet, and config flag. We'll canary the bypass at 40%.

ingest-bot: deploy-bot: rollback not requested. Canary rollout: v2.3-selector-bypass -> 40% at 9865432120.

kevin: Also add a unit test for kernel selector to assert no extra copies for tiny frames (mock the frame and ensure copy_count stays same).

maria: And add telemetry: writev_count histogram and demux_cpu p99 on streaming routes so we catch regressions automatically.

aj: PR posted 9865432128 -> https://git.internal/r/ingress/PR/472 (bench + strace).

sasha: Starting canary evaluation. Will post telemetry around 9865432135.

kevin: Reminder to check KV cache keys: if demux mutates key normalization it could cause subtle evictions. kv_probe looked low but monitor hits/evicts across canary.

maria: Action items: aj -> PR + bench, kevin -> unit test + kv metric watch, sasha -> canary strace/writev telemetry. 10m follow-up tomorrow.

aj: Thanks all. Posting results soon. :thumbsup:
